# The Idea Registry

**This is the retrieval surface for Hornvale's speculative ideas — one line
each, scannable and greppable.** The [`frontier.md`](frontier.md) essays hold
the *argument*; this holds the *index*. Consult this table **before proposing
or reopening any idea** — an entry marked `rejected` or `ratified` is a
settled question, and reopening one needs new information, not a fresh
opinion. Then read the linked essay to understand it.
Like the essays it indexes, this chapter is part of The Frontier — the
book's clearly-marked speculative part; it records ambitions and verdicts,
not merged reality, and governs nothing.

Scope: this registry tracks the **vision/idea pipeline** — the speculative
directions that flow frontier → spec → build. Settled *engineering
constraints* (no `HashMap`, no wall-clock, typed quantities, …) live in the
[decision log](https://github.com/hornvale/hornvale/blob/main/docs/decisions/) and are not duplicated here; where a vision
idea *became* a decision, its row cross-links the decision instead of
restating it.

## How to read a row

- **ID** — a stable category-prefixed handle (`MAP-7`, `BIO-4`, …). IDs are
  permanent; a superseded idea keeps its ID and flips its status. New ideas
  take the next free number in their category; never renumber.
- **Status** — where the idea sits in the pipeline:
  - `shipped` — built and merged into the world.
  - `ratified (NNNN)` — settled as a decision; the number links the record.
  - `spec'd` — draining into a binding spec; **Where** points at the spec,
    not the essay.
  - `elaborated` — has a full essay in `frontier.md`; awaiting a spec.
  - `raw` — captured but not yet elaborated; a stub, not an argument.
  - `rejected` — considered and set aside; the row says why. **This is the
    anti-relitigation payload — the registry's most important status.**
  - `refuted (evidence)` — the row's own central claim was tested and found
    false, and no artifact shipped from it; the parenthetical citing what
    refuted it (a campaign name or a decision number) is required.
    `rejected` is a decision — we considered it and set it aside. `refuted`
    is a measurement — we tested it and reality said no.

  These seven are the whole vocabulary — the seventh, `refuted`, was opened
  deliberately by [decision 0131](https://github.com/hornvale/hornvale/blob/main/docs/decisions/0131-refuted-is-a-seventh-registry-status.md)
  — and a drift-check enforces it. Category prefixes are open — coin a new
  one when an idea needs it — but statuses are not; do not invent an eighth.
- **Conf** — the essay's confidence tag, condensed (high / med / low /
  taste-gated), or `—` for settled/process rows.
- **Where** — the essay or record that elaborates it.

When an idea drains into a spec, flip its status and point **Where** at the
spec: the elaboration relocates, the breadcrumb stays, nothing is lost.
Repointing **Where** *replaces* a row's prose rather than appending to it —
the campaign narrative lives in the chronicle the row now links.

**Rows are capped at 600 characters of Idea prose**, enforced in CI. A row is
a shelf-mark: what the idea is, plus a pointer to where it is argued. If a row
needs a page, it needs a `frontier.md` essay and a status of `elaborated` —
not a longer row. The authoring rules live in this directory's `CLAUDE.md`.

| MAP-gate-by-incidence | Individually-limited abilities compose into an unlimited one — the failure fifteen parts of magic-system analysis ended on. Two detection spells with complementary blind spots have no blind spot: each one's designed weakness is annulled by owning both, so the author's only fix was to *withhold*, which is what a class is for. [[MAP-27]]'s author-M+N promise carries this risk unnamed — emergent affordances mean designed gaps compose away. The sim's answer is not a class but **incidence** ([[UNI-24]]): costs located in the world, so scarcity gates access diegetically | raw | high | ideonomy session 2026-07-31 (magic-system design patterns); [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |
| MAP-two-axis-options | An option set varying on one axis collapses to a ranking — why elemental damage devolves to one right answer. If fire and frost are equally available and equally effective the element carries no information; if fire is stronger, resisting it is just a stat. The fix is to make element co-vary with *shape*, so switching damage type forces switching range and posture. Generalised: options must differ jointly on two axes or more, or they are a ladder wearing a menu. The third joint-over-marginal finding here, beside [[KNOW-deduction-gain]] and [[MAP-archetypes]] | raw | high | ideonomy session 2026-07-31 (magic-system design patterns) |
| MAP-thaumeme-layers | Two layers, not one: **productions are discovered** (facts about the seed's physics, universal within a world) and **accords are invented** (named mid-level derivations — cultural, per-seed, historically caused). The seam explains an asymmetry the design would otherwise assert: fluency in productions transfers between playthroughs and accord knowledge does not, because the lower layer is found and the upper made. The drawn lemma set of the cluster's tier-0 sequencing is this layer. See [[MAP-naming-as-progression]] | elaborated | med | design session 2026-08-06; [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |
| MAP-naming-as-progression | A derivation becomes cheap only once it is **named**, so the accord vocabulary is a budget the player curates rather than a list handed over, and its size is the practical power ceiling. This closes [[MAP-gate-by-incidence]]'s leak: deriving around the named layer costs full proof length every time, leaving flexibility unbounded in principle and prohibitive in practice. Mathematics and cuisine both run on it — a lemma worth reusing gets a name, which is how a working vocabulary stays small while its reachable space does not | elaborated | med | design session 2026-08-06; [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |
| MAP-prover-locus | Traditions are positions rather than classes, on a factorisation orthogonal to the balance-sheet one: **rule ownership × search-at-cast**. Wizardry owns and searches; sorcery owns and never searches; clericism does neither; shamanism searches by negotiation over rules it does not own. Generated by negating the scholastic model one definitional property at a time. Because a tradition is a position, an unoccupied corner is **foundable** — a culture can invent one in play. Rate, direction and homogeneity then give each its signature | elaborated | med | design session 2026-08-06; [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |
| MAP-vision-decoding | A prover deriving over rules the petitioner does not hold must report in its own vocabulary, so **a symbolic vision is a type mismatch and decoding is the type conversion** — a real proof in a language not yet held. Difficulty is dictionary coverage, so progression *is* dictionary growth; partial decoding yields a derivation with a hole; a mis-decode does not error but substitutes a well-formed wrong symbol and **runs**. Symbols must be culturally motivated or it is a cipher. Rendered by the Teller, interpreted communally | elaborated | med | design session 2026-08-06; [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |
| MAP-closed-canon | Necromancy defined structurally rather than thematically — **the prover is dead**, so the canon cannot grow and advancement is archaeology. What is recovered is a *particular* dead practitioner's idiosyncratic repertoire, acquired whole with its naming rationale lost. Recovery degrades the source, so rules drawn from spoiled ones still fire but yield something adjacent. Recency of death grades negotiation into extraction. The taboo is **conservation, not sentiment**, which makes the practice licensable rather than hunted | elaborated | med | design session 2026-08-06; [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |
| MAP-spell-corpus | A published spell list read as a [0095](https://github.com/hornvale/hornvale/blob/main/docs/decisions/0095-a-corpus-is-an-instrument-never-a-standard.md) instrument — declared bias, never a standard. Its job is **parameter calibration, not coverage audit**: how many named units a satisfying space carries, and at what composition depth. Those are extractable numbers and they set the accord generator's parameters. Stored as decomposition and provenance rather than as text, as the tvtropes corpus already is — which is also what licensing permits | elaborated | med | design session 2026-08-06; [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |
| MAP-metric-temporality | Metric temporality is an unnamed axis — a terminal snapshot is a biased estimator of a trajectory, which is why Cogmind records *peak state* and *favourite item* beside final state. Comparing an instantaneous metric across worlds of unlike histories may compare unlike things | raw | med | ideonomy session 2026-07-31 (roguelike morgue files); [frontier §map](frontier.md#the-frontier-map) |

| MAP-refugium-has-two-terms | A refuge is not merely a place nobody passes — low betweenness alone describes empty ground. | MAP-encounter-is-a-product | You meet people where YOUR path and THEIRS both go, so encounter rate is the product of two path distributions and the surface squares. An ambush predator's optimal station is the betweenness maximum — a highwayman, a trapdoor spider — retiring the wandering-monster table in favour of derived behaviour. A market stall wants the same cell, allocated by bid-rent ([[MAP-22]] one scale down), and the two uses compete for it, so the contest is derived | elaborated | high | [frontier §betweenness](frontier.md#betweenness--one-surface-many-readouts) |
| MAP-the-road-with-no-builder | Derived infrastructure that the culture believes was authored. [[MAP-19]]/[[MAP-20]]'s folk-knowledge gap pointed at artifice, where it is sharper: a wrong belief about a road generates a founder figure, a claim of descent, and a territorial argument | elaborated | high | [frontier §betweenness](frontier.md#betweenness--one-surface-many-readouts) |
| MAP-chokepoint-is-a-detour-cost | A graph bridge is boolean and a strategic chokepoint is not — the bridge is the degenerate case where detour cost is infinite. The Twins fails the definition and is the worked example: not "no other crossing" but "the other crossing costs three weeks". So the measure is detour cost against a BUDGET, hence time-varying. Tarjan is O(V+E), far cheaper than all-pairs. And a chokepoint is a fact about the MODALITY SET, so adding a mode destroys one ([[MAP-55]], [[MAP-11]]) | elaborated | high | [frontier §chokepoints](frontier.md#chokepoints--the-bridge-is-the-degenerate-case) |
| MAP-bridges-are-borders | A realm's natural borders are its bridges — derive regions from 2-edge-connectivity instead of authoring them, replacing a Voronoi blob around a capital with a topological object and yielding the march for free. The two graph primitives split into two settlement archetypes: an edge-chokepoint grows a CASTLE with a toll and a holding lineage, a vertex-chokepoint a CAPITAL that cannot be bypassed. Scale-relative: a door, a pass, a strait | elaborated | high | [frontier §chokepoints](frontier.md#chokepoints--the-bridge-is-the-degenerate-case) |
| MAP-the-toll-is-the-inverse-desire-path | A chokepoint is not found, it is made, and the making runs the desire-path loop backwards: a detour maximum attracts a fortification, which converts detour cost into RENT. One mechanism at two signs — emergent feedback LOWERING cost versus a deliberate institution RAISING it — and a ford gets both at once. The rent is bounded by the detour, so the equilibrium toll is derivable rather than authored and falls the moment a rival crossing opens | elaborated | high | [frontier §chokepoints](frontier.md#chokepoints--the-bridge-is-the-degenerate-case) |
| MAP-biconnectivity-is-a-feudalism-knob | The distribution of detour costs sets how feudal a world can be. In a fully biconnected graph no place is worth holding and the map is politically flat, so strategic geography is a property of the generated terrain: river-cut and archipelagic land yields many petty holders with real leverage, flat steppe admits empire or nothing. Preregistered as a monotone relation between bridge density and polity count at fixed population; the null is that [[MAP-61]] has no bridges at all | elaborated | high | [frontier §chokepoints](frontier.md#chokepoints--the-bridge-is-the-degenerate-case) |
| MAP-fmm-is-wrong-for-paths | The Fast Multipole Method does not accelerate all-pairs shortest paths, and the adjacency is misleading enough to record. FMM sums a smoothly decaying kernel; shortest-path is min-plus algebra, and a `min` admits no multipole expansion — there is no way to write "the shortest route through this distant cluster" as a truncated moment series. The right family for hierarchical routing is contraction hierarchies, hub labelling and transit-node routing | rejected | high | [frontier §far-field](frontier.md#the-far-field-is-low-rank--multipole-summaries-and-one-way-aggregation) |
| MAP-multipole-is-a-sufficient-statistic | A far-away many is a near-away few, to controlled precision — a multipole expansion is a sufficient statistic for far-field influence, with an error bound set by truncation order. This world answers "what does a distant aggregate look like?" ad hoc in four places; the method gives that answer a form and an error bar, reframing level-of-detail as a controlled approximation. The moments render as prose, and truncation order is [[NARR-altitude]]'s rung | elaborated | med | [frontier §far-field](frontier.md#the-far-field-is-low-rank--multipole-summaries-and-one-way-aggregation) |
| MAP-moments-merge-classifications-do-not | Why decision 0038 may aggregate one way where FMM cannot — the asymmetry is forced by algebra, not by conservatism. FMM's aggregate is an associative SUM, so two clusters' moments merge into the pair's exactly, which is what makes its upward pass sound. Coarse truth here is CATEGORICAL (biome by max-weight corner inheritance) and categorical aggregation is not associative: tundra and steppe have no merged parent. A justification the decision record does not give | elaborated | high | [frontier §far-field](frontier.md#the-far-field-is-low-rank--multipole-summaries-and-one-way-aggregation) |

| MAP-22 | The biogeography of coexistence — placement-as-competitive-exclusion collapses a many-species world to one (Gause), so the strong quietly erase the weak; coexistence must be *held open* by pricing might. The reframe: might buys COST and RARITY, not ubiquity; weakness buys ABUNDANCE and REFUGE. Five composable, deterministic mechanisms: **carrying cost** (suitability as cell-yield-vs-species-need; the mighty viable in few cells → rare, the ecological rubber band), **niche differentiation** (cells as resource vectors, placement as matching not scalar ranking), the **might-ordered draft** (pick in decreasing might; the mighty pick first but few), **refugia + stratification** (the underdark stratum, commensal tenancy — kobolds in the dragon's shadow; a cell is a stack), **contingent succession** (biogeography as deep-time residue; incumbency shields the weak, extinctions open ground). Placement sibling of MAP-11 (habitat medium) and the biosphere carrying-capacity term. The deeper reframe: the placement stack **optimizes the wrong objective** — per-cell fitness-argmax *manufactures* monoculture; the realistic model is **diversity-under-viability**, a *clearing* problem in four layers (**substrate** = niche heterogeneity + underworld strata; **allocation** = a clearing *market* where might is a budget and cells carry emergent prices so everyone affords something, == the draft == largest-first bin-packing; **coupling** = one scalar, might, driving priority↑ footprint↑ count↓; **maintenance** = a *disturbance pump*, intermediate-disturbance + storage effect, keeping diversity alive over deep time). The minimal down-payment is a **founder floor** (reserve each people its best cell before competitive placement — the allocation layer at K=1). Surfaced in The Branches when a stronger authored people (hobgoblin) Pareto-dominated goblin off the map; the founder floor is the in-scope L1 unblock. **The founder floor shipped and migrated** to the new `demography` domain (campaign *The Gathering*, MAP-7's field half) — it now floors over attractors of that campaign's carrying-capacity flow rather than suitability scores, behavior preserved. The rest of this row's mechanisms (carrying cost, niche differentiation, the might-ordered draft, refugia + stratification, contingent succession) drained into a full design, the **coexistence-stack spec**, building on MAP-7's shipped field: footprint-as-mass-scaled-home-range and multi-grain density stacking; coexistence by a temperature-controlled `K^β` normalized share against competitors and a viability floor; bidirectional trophic coupling; soft-capacity overflow; and the derived byproducts (the strife field, wilderness-from-fragmentation, refugia). | MAP-53 | **The debt is drainage — ley-lines as the erosional record of magical history, and the MAP-40/MAP-42 reconciliation.** MAP-40 banked a thaumic re-instantiation of the carve, resting on engine A's seam being written potential-agnostically *on purpose*; UNI-24's conservative magic supplies the one thing that row needs and does not have — **something that flows**. Then a caster is a **sink**, the land drains toward the working, and repeated casting at a place *incises a channel*: **a ley-line is an erosion feature**, not a drawn map — the accumulated scar of magical history, computed by the shipped carve and authored by nobody. It is also **extraction infrastructure**: the flux network is the sole exception to UNI-24's source = incidence identity, so it lets a mage draw from *elsewhere*, carrying the debt from hinterland to throne — the capital lush, the periphery ash. Core-periphery magical imperialism therefore becomes a **centrality claim about the flux graph**, the same checkable-invariant class UNI-5's stones lean on (diameter / connectivity / centrality), and Sorcerer-Kings sitting on nexuses become the *predicted* configuration rather than set dressing. **The reconciliation:** MAP-40 requires a conserved flux and MAP-42 is explicitly *ex nihilo* — the two banked rows quietly contradict, unnoticed because both are `raw`. Tiering makes both coherent: the conservative rung has a flux and therefore has ley-lines; the ex-nihilo rung sits above it and does not carve. Coarse constrains fine, applied to metaphysics — and it is an argument from two existing rows, not from preference | elaborated | med | [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |
| MAP-54 | **The surprisal budget — pricing fate's moves instead of gating them.** Addresses the one problem MAP-15's delimited event-game explicitly names as unsolved: the plausibility floor "has to be calibrated so that fate reads as uncanny inevitability rather than an authored cheat, and that calibration is a taste-and-Lab problem, not a formula." **The diagnosis: the floor is overloaded.** It is a *per-move* predicate being asked to enforce a property of the *whole chain* — raise it and fate is too weak to steer, lower it and fate works miracles, and neither setting can see the most common failure at all (many marginally-plausible moves, each clearing the bar, reading as relentless background rigging). That is a type error, not a tuning failure, and no value of the floor fixes it. **The fix:** give fate a **budget denominated in surprisal** (`-ln(p)` per transition) across the chain, and keep the floor for per-move magnitude — two knobs, two failure modes, each calibrating against a signal that is actually visible. A budget also produces the *right* texture where a threshold cannot: under a threshold every above-line move is free, so fate rigs constantly; under a budget **fate economises** — losing skirmishes, spending nothing on the ordinary, saving for the one branch that decides it. Fate is not strong; fate is thrifty. Implementable in existing machinery (spending surprisal *is* biasing seeded draws). It also closes prophecy into UNI-24's conservation frame with exact units — the future's optionality is entropy, a prophecy costs the bits it removes, and **overlapping prophecies compete for the same entropy**, so contradiction is detectable as a *budget overflow* before it becomes a narrative one. **Honest limit:** does not eliminate taste — B's value is still tasted — but decomposes one badly-posed taste problem into two well-posed ones, promoting the mechanism from taste-checked to calibration-checked | raw | med | ideonomy session 2026-07-16 |
| MAP-55 | **Coastline complexity as a culture driver, not a terrain stat — the thalassocracy thesis.** rift-and-fit measures coastline complexity (shoreline-development, coast-roughness) purely as an *effect* of terrain and checks it against a band; it drives *nothing*. But in every domain that has one, coastline complexity is a *cause*: it is habitat-edge (the littoral is the richest ecotone — more coast = more fishing subsistence, coastal endemism, littoral carrying-capacity), it is port geometry (indented coasts make harbors; smooth coasts don't), and — the load-bearing claim — it is the split between **maritime/fragmented/trading** polities and **continental/centralized** ones (Greece and Norway are seafaring *because* their coasts are fractal; the smooth African coast bred continental states). Re-instantiate coastline complexity as an *input* to demography and culture: a per-landmass (not whole-globe) coastal-complexity field feeding a littoral carrying-capacity bonus (MAP-7) and a maritime-vs-continental cultural axis. This is where the campaign's coastline work should have *led* — the number was never the point, the driver is. Needs per-landmass/per-region coastline measurement (not the single whole-globe scalar) | raw | high | ideonomy session 2026-07-16 (rift-and-fit G6); relates MAP-7, MAP-59 |

| MAP-61 | The connection graph — society's transport topology. Social distance is *graph* distance, not Euclidean: nodes are places, edges are spatial adjacency + roads + sailing lanes + portals (a portal makes distant cells adjacent), so non-local coupling is native. Edges derived from the sandboxes below (currents→lanes, passes→roads) + built by society (a road = a baked-history event); conductance gated in time by climate (seasonal lanes), astronomy (intermittent portals), events (a curse closing a route), rarely *partitioning* the graph (isolation → divergence → rediscovery). Interactions split on the Fields/Facts seam: diffuse coupling (trade / culture / disease) = an order-independent fixed-point over the sparse graph; discrete coupling (raid / founding / plague) = events propagating with edge-specific lag. Coarse-global baked / fine-local lazy; Lorenz-safe. Triple-duty: dynamics substrate, discoverable legibility surface, player travel network. Diasporas & cultural similarity track graph-distance. Distinct from the relational [[SOC-9]]. **Slice 1 shipped** (campaign *The Connection Graph*, following *The Living Community* [[SOC-10]] C1): `domains/topology` (kernel-only) owns the graph type + pure reachability/least-cost ops (the kernel's deterministic `astar`); `windows/worldgen` derives it from real geography — bare adjacency, ocean-current sailing lanes, and bounded least-cost land corridors (a terrain traversal-cost field) — purely on demand, never committed (no epoch; every world stays byte-identical). Measured: on the icosphere, open ocean is the real hard separator, not elevation (a one-gap ridge does not isolate — a great-circle path dips through the gap "for free"; only genuinely impassable ocean does), and isolation is locally invisible — a hub can hold more local sailing-lane and land-route links than the world's best-connected capital while still being globally cut off from it, the structural precondition [[SOC-criticality]]'s divergence needs. Legible via the almanac/CLI `connections` verb and a seed-42 gallery page. **Deferred, by design, to later slices**: built roads (society's historical marks — needs history×graph co-evolution), portals (magic/astronomy-gated), conductance gating in time (seasonal lanes, intermittent portals), and diffuse coupling (trade/culture/disease as a fixed-point over the sparse graph). **Slice 2 shipped** (campaign *The Sundering*): the dynamics rewire — migration/raid/daughter-founding now follow a **time-varying** connection graph (one graph per era; a cell is ocean where its elevation lies below that era's sea level), so glacial low-stands open land bridges and the rising sea sunders the peoples who crossed. A genesis epoch (the graph stays derived, never committed, but the skeleton it drives moves). Measured: the graph works richly (11 of 12 seed-42 climate migrations cross era-only water; the glacial low-stand reconnects 755/843 refugia) and isolation genuinely diverges the peoples (four sea-bound landmasses over four peoples, three hosting only a proper subset — a people that could not cross is absent from that shore); but the diaspora *volume* is honestly modest — the old bake's larger count was inflated by unphysical ocean-walking, and the remaining lever is crowding/pressure, handed to [[SOC-criticality]]. Still deferred: built roads, portals, conductance gating, diffuse coupling. | elaborated (slice-2 shipped) | med | [The Connection Graph chronicle](../chronicle/the-connection-graph.md); [The Sundering chronicle](../chronicle/the-sundering.md); [frontier §connection-graph](frontier.md#the-connection-graph--societys-transport-topology) |
| MAP-impression | The impression — every group or individual that occupies or passes through a place leaves a trace, and the *set* of traces tells the story of who was here; the full generalisation of *The Living Community*'s minimal residue slice [[SOC-10]]. Four axes. (1) **Durability by material** — perishable (rag doll, wood, food, still-warm campfire ash: decades) / durable (potsherds, arrowheads, worked stone, bone, foundations, the ruin itself: millennia — Chaco, Mesa Verde, the tell of Jericho rebuilt at every level) / near-eternal (a magical sceptre, a dwarven vault: ~25k yr) — so an ancient ruin still yields durable finds while perishable finds survive only *recent* turnover. (2) **Character by species/culture** — elf near-invisible, orc burned forests + bone + ash + collapsed keeps, dwarf mines, human historical marks, fae nothing — the impression tells *who* passed through. (3) **Cause + geography shape it** — sacked keep vs abandoned hamlet vs plague-pit; mountain mine vs forest clearing (geographic determinism). (4) **The full trace range** — still-warm ash, a ruined castle, the scorched scattered skeleton of a dragon's last meal — not only settlements. NOT a dig-minigame: the traces are simply *there*, telling the story. The vivid perishable finds of sudden flight (a child's toy dropped as a family flees, never to return) couple with [[SOC-criticality]] conflict in a world of monstrous species contesting territory. Cross-links the species and culture domains. | raw | high | [The Living Community](../chronicle/the-living-community.md) (minimal slice shipped) |

Checked directly against the code before naming this "just a reuse": it is NOT. Two real, separately-sized pieces of new ground surfaced researching it. (1) **Physics**: today's seasonal temperature swing (`domains/climate/src/provider.rs`) is an EXACT sinusoid on a fixed `year_length_std` — no drift, so a naive model of it would never miss; weather (`domains/climate/src/weather.rs`, The Firmament) is pure Fbm noise with NO seasonal tie at all (`storm_propensity` is a static per-cell constant). A tongue can sit at the capacity floor with zero core homophony and still be characterless — measured: 17 of the 18 shipped tongues contain **zero** words with a liquid, Kobold 75 of 86. Neither [[LANG-41]] nor [[LANG-45]] names this failure mode: the tongues are genuinely diverse, and the whole reachable region is narrow | raw | high | The Burr, 2026-08-19; [chronicle](../chronicle/the-burr.md) — the measured motive |
| LANG-nativize-crosses-sonorancy | **`nativize` crosses the sonorant/obstruent boundary to save a place feature, stripping the character a phonology was built to carry.** `same_class` means only "both consonants" and `feature_distance` weights place/manner/voicing **equally**, so for `r` (alveolar/trill) the sibilant `z` scores 1 and the approximant `j` scores 2 — `z` wins. Measured in The Burr: desert-elf and wood-elf drew a glide, inherited proto roots carrying a trill, and lost every liquid to `z`, capping that campaign at 6 of 18 tongues where 8 were reachable. Sonorancy is load-bearing for character; place is cosmetic | raw | high | The Burr, 2026-08-19; [chronicle](../chronicle/the-burr.md); `etymology.rs` `nativize` |
| LANG-untraced-nativization | **A derivation trace reads "no change" while the form changed.** The dictionary renders `Sreng → no change → Szeng` for desert-elf: the cascade fired no rule so the trace honestly reports none, but `nativize` then substituted `r`→`z` reaching the daughter's inventory, and nativization is not a rule and is never traced. Readers of the committed dictionary see a derivation omitting the step that changed the word, invisible exactly where it matters — a segment the daughter cannot produce. Independent of [[LANG-nativize-crosses-sonorancy]] | raw | high | The Burr, 2026-08-19; [chronicle](../chronicle/the-burr.md); dictionary desert-elf rows |
| LANG-tongue-pronouns | **A tongue has no pronoun inventory, so `Subject::Pronoun` gaps.** The Scarf made the refusal honest and pointed it here; The Inquest drew the inventory, so the gap's antecedent is false and the arm is deleted rather than left unreachable. Six slots, person x number, no gender — nothing in the ledger assigns one. Drawn per family through the same proto-plus-cascade every cognate morpheme uses, on new permanent stream labels. What is NOT drawn: inclusive/exclusive, animacy splits, honorific registers, and any pronoun beyond the personal series | shipped | med | [The Inquest](../chronicle/the-inquest.md) |
| LANG-parse-tongue | **The empty branch: Common is bidirectional by construction, a tongue is write-only.** `parse_common` inverts `realize_common` and is deliberately caller-less; nothing inverts `realize_tongue`. Before The Scarf the idea was not even nameable — two clause types meant no single target to parse INTO; one `Clause` makes `parse_tongue` a second instance of an existing pairing rather than a new invention. Recognition is where controlled languages rot ([[LANG-3]]), so this wants a frozen `sentences/` corpus to measure against before it is built | raw | med | [The Scarf](../chronicle/the-scarf.md) |
| LANG-paradigm-wiring | **`paradigm.rs` was drawn and had zero consumers; two of its four axes have one now.** The Inquest wired `tense_depth` and added `polarity_depth` beside it, so a tongue marks past and negative by prefix, suffix, particle or not at all, per its own draw — and a per-tongue assembler puts them in production rather than only in tests. **`number_depth` is still unread**, and an assertion in `grammar.rs` says so in place: no tongue inflects its complement for number, which is what this row still holds. The morphology really is already drawn, so no new label is needed for it | shipped (tense and polarity halves) | high (mechanism exists) | [The Inquest](../chronicle/the-inquest.md) |
| LANG-role-marking | **A tongue marks no roles, and the fix is NOT free — it needs new draws.** `realize_adjuncts` matches on the argument and never reads `adjunct.role`, so the flagship tail `18822 25 1600` is ambiguous between site, founding and ending. Role surfaces are adpositions and case, and **neither exists in `domains/language`** — no adposition machinery, no case dimension in `typology.rs`. The Interlinear's chronicle said `paradigm.rs` already drew them; The Scarf corrected that. Drawing them means new permanent stream labels, i.e. a save-format contract | raw | med | [The Scarf](../chronicle/the-scarf.md) |
| LANG-clause-connectivity | **A clause was an island with no field pointing at another — The Mortise closed that ceiling.** `Argument::Clause`/`Subject::Clause` embed one clause inside another (capped at one level); `Coordination` joins two as a list above `Clause`. Both share only a boundary marker, which is what keeps the parser's inverse computable — The Inquest's own finding, confirmed rather than merely assumed. What remains outside it: right-node raising, nominalization, temporal adverbials ([[LANG-clause-nominalization-and-ellipsis]], [[LANG-adjectival-predication]]) | shipped (embedding one level + coordination tiers 1–2) | high (mechanism exists) | [The Mortise](../chronicle/the-mortise.md) |
| LANG-mood | **Mood is the fifth promised speaker feature and nothing draws it.** Number, definiteness, evidential, tense and polarity are all on the clause now; mood is not, in either register — no clause field, no `paradigm.rs` axis, no stream label, no marker form. It is what a question, an imperative and a wish have in common, so it is upstream of the corpus's polar-question and wh-question demands rather than a sibling of them. Drawing it means a new permanent stream label per axis, i.e. a save-format contract, on the additive pattern The Inquest's polarity axis established | raw | med | [The Inquest](../chronicle/the-inquest.md) |
| LANG-aspect | **Tense shipped without aspect, and the two are routinely conflated.** The clause distinguishes present from past and nothing else: no progressive, no perfect, no habitual, no completive. Cross-linguistically many tongues grammaticalize aspect where they do not grammaticalize tense at all, so an aspect axis is not a refinement of the tense axis but a peer of it — with its own depth draw, its own position draw and its own marked member. Cheap to state, and the reason to record it is that a future campaign reading `Tense::Past` may assume perfective and be wrong | raw | med | [The Inquest](../chronicle/the-inquest.md) |
| LANG-common-person-axis | **Common has no person agreement, so it asserts *"I eats the bread"*.** `COPULA_PARADIGM` and `VERB_PARADIGM` are keyed by number only; the surface is pinned by a test so the roughness is visible rather than latent. Adding a person axis widens both tables and also changes the parse-side search, which is why it was not free. It bought nothing the corpus needed — English negation is periphrastic, so *"I did not know them"* leaves the stem bare — but any campaign rendering a first- or second-person positive present in Common will meet it immediately | raw | low | [The Inquest](../chronicle/the-inquest.md) |
| LANG-particle-splice-order | **Particle marking and affix marking layer in OPPOSITE orders, and neither is wrong on its own terms.** For affixes the evidential ends outermost; for particles the last splice lands NEAREST the predicate, so the evidential sits adjacent and tense furthest out. The inconsistency predates The Inquest, which found it while adding the second and third marking layers, followed the existing convention exactly and documented the placement factually rather than inventing a layering theory the code does not have. Deciding which order is right — or that both are, for stated reasons — is the work | raw | low | [The Inquest](../chronicle/the-inquest.md) |

## The unification thesis

| ID     | Idea                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Status     | Conf          | Where                                                       |

Truth held static this slice, so ignorance (never perceived) is the one demonstrated divergence; staleness (a changing truth) and deception (UNI-16's credulity threshold) are reserved as later, harder instances of the same inference mechanic — [The Surmise chronicle](../chronicle/the-surmise.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | elaborated | — (thesis)    | [frontier §unification](frontier.md#the-unification-thesis) |

Signal detection theory gives the form: d′ and criterion are **orthogonal**; Hornvale authored the criterion (`threat_response`, flee 0 ↔ stand 1) and has no d′, so every people in every world discriminates perfectly and differs only in nerve | raw | med | [frontier §unification](frontier.md#the-unification-thesis) |

| UNI-6  | Place-bound afterlife civilizations — where the metaphysics animates the dead (UNI-4), a persistent ghost population is not merely a phenomenon the living infer over but a *second society* with its own accreting culture and identity, and the place is its body: the architecture is the substrate BIO-22 thought incorporeal species lacked (EXP-6), and the dead are the ultimate sessile people (BIO-18), bound to the structure. Demography inverts — its births are the living's deaths (recruitment from those who die in the place), so a castle that sees war and plague accretes deep death-cohort strata, the oldest ghosts the founder-elders (MEM-7 with the floating gap never closing: firsthand deep-time memory, the only culture that has it). The memory economy runs on masonry — melt is driven not by time (immortal witnesses do not forget) but by *substrate decay*, so a fallen wing is lost neighbourhoods and lost memory, MEM-4 preservation becomes keeping the castle standing, and the quick and the dead are an unwitting mutualism mediated by upkeep (MAP-7 founding→neglect→death, mirrored on the dead's side). The change-engine under perfect memory: the dead perceive the living only as confusing glimpses (broken perception, EXP-3), never their motives, and take in the present only through newly-arrived ghosts — themselves confused, terrified, inarticulate — so ghost culture drifts not by forgetting but by *compounding misapprehension*, an inverted knowledge gradient in which the dead know the ancient past firsthand and the present worst of all. Firm choices: determinism > speed (BTreeMap, single-threaded sim), data-not-code (0011), open extension (add a domain, edit nothing), in-memory until measured scale demands the LSM (0037). Surfaced by The Niche's menagerie forcing a fungus to carry a proto-language. **Program metaplan APPROVED** (2026-07-15): the design converged over six ideonomy drills + a pressure-test onto one lens — every boundary is a *rate* boundary (the constitution's build-state/world-state/derived-view split applied to entities) — settling `KindId`-as-label (not position), `ComponentStore` = generalized `VertexMap`, Facts-vs-registries = the build/world line, the query engine as SPO/PSO/OSP triple-store indexes, the schedule as a derived view over the capability schema, direction-split + bulk-synchronous-tick concurrency (the deterministic form of agent-based modelling), and two determinism contracts (serialized-kind-ref = label + epoch; single-writer-per-functional-predicate). **Campaign 1 SHIPPED** as *The Menagerie* (2026-07-15): `SpeciesDef` split into a universal `BiosphereTraits` + `Option<PeopledTraits>`, the 12-creature canonical menagerie authored biosphere-only (the first non-peopled entities), genesis cut over onto the competitive niche-K stack (peoples' 2-way biogeography now committed). The kernel gained `ComponentStore<K, C>` (the generalized `VertexMap`) + an open (unsealed) `Component` marker; the old `Option<PeopledTraits>` all-or-nothing became a worldgen **referential-integrity check** (peopled cluster key-set + biosphere row + multi-member-family proto, load-time, fails loudly); genesis relocated to the composition root reading the component set. The no-domain→domain layering is now **enforced by construction** — `species` cannot read `language`'s speech because it cannot depend on it. Byte-identical throughout. The design surprise, folded in: the roster *is* a component-set (synthetic Lab rosters forced it), more faithful than the canonical-lookup the plan assumed. **Campaign 4 SHIPPED** as *The Concordance* (2026-07-17): the flat `Vec<Fact>` ledger gained three triple-store permutation indexes (`SPO`/`PSO`/`OSP`) + compiler-style predicate interning, entirely as `#[serde(skip)]` derived views — `commit`'s two linear scans (idempotency + contradiction) collapse to one prefix lookup, so world-build drops from `O(n²)` to `O(n log n)`; postings are ascending fact positions, so every query preserves commit order and every artifact stays byte-identical. The keystone is the INDEX≡SCAN property (index provably equals the naive scan over random ledgers) — which the whole-branch review sharpened by catching that an Entity-only generator had exempted the one value where `total_cmp` and IEEE equality disagree, signed zero (fixed in the index key alone, save untouched). Plus a `kinds_with(component)` reflection query (UNI-21's capability read). **Campaign 5 SHIPPED** as *The Individuation* (2026-07-17): the instance half of the substrate — a canonical `instance-of` kernel predicate (non-functional, latest-wins `kind_of`, `mint_instance` as sole writer) gives every entity a day-stamped, provenanced kind history; a per-call derived lens (`instance_biosphere`) answers an instance's effective traits as its own override facts (mass, potency) else its kind's authored registry default, overrides surviving a kind change by construction; three new body-less kinds (deity, culture, material) prove the component-set matrix, and `awakened-owlbear` (biosphere + the full peopled cluster, reached by transition) proves the kind ⋈ instance join in a `from_stores` test roster; the canonical kind roster generalizes to the union of every component store's key-set. | UNI-23 | **Magic as a graph grammar** — the missing answer to "what is a *rule*" in UNI-2's second physics. **The Fact ledger already IS the graph** (subject/predicate/object = an edge-labelled digraph), so a production is a **triple-pattern match** (preconditions) plus an **append** (effects), and the matcher is UNI-22's approved SPO/PSO/OSP query engine — no new storage, no new addressing, just a rule table. **A spell is a *derivation*, not a production**: primitives compose, so a finite drawn table yields an unbounded spell space, research is proof search, a grimoire is a lemma cache, and **spell level = derivation depth** (formal, unauthored, unbalanced-by-hand). The catalog is **authored and committed** — decision [0009](https://github.com/hornvale/hornvale/blob/main/docs/decisions/0009-models-author-dice-roll.md) names "expert-system rule bases" verbatim — and the world **draws a subset + parameters**; a freely-drawn grammar would generate semantic noise, buying combinatorial size at the cost of meaning. Addressing is **sympathetic** (similarity = trait-vector proximity; contagion = reachability through the ledger's past, free because append-only) plus a third mode, **presence** (EXP-3-gated direct awareness — what psionics uses, which is why it feels categorically different without being different physics). Effects are **licensed violations read off the property batteries**: every invariant the sim enforces is a candidate magic, so the catalog is meaningful *and* checkable by construction and **grows with the sim's fidelity** (UNI-21's shape). Sourcing discipline: Frazer's two laws as **cognitive** primitives (Rozin & Nemeroff), never his discredited evolutionist ladder; Evans-Pritchard marks the limit (magic-as-explanation ≠ magic-as-technology; both must exist). Realizes UNI-2; gated by DOM-17, downstream of UNI-22's query engine | elaborated | med | [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |
| UNI-24 | **Conservation, incidence, and the scar** — *the debt is not the environmental cost*. Conservation (a production takes from somewhere) is the candidate universal; **incidence** (who bears it) is drawn, and the land is one of five (self / land / others / the future / the dead) — a self-incidence world has burnout mages and no defiling at all. **The scar is universal; where it lands is drawn**: one parameter, five recognisable worlds. Conservation forces **source = incidence** (you cannot take from one place and charge another) with one exception, a flux network (MAP-53). **The debt is the diagnostic phenomenon**, the cluster's best result: ex-nihilo magic leaves no residue and is therefore *undiscoverable*, while conservative magic leaves a scar that *is* the evidence cultures infer over — so the property that makes magic **checkable for us** is the property that makes it **discoverable for them**, and verification surface and in-world epistemology collapse to one axis (the governing principle stops being methodology and becomes a fact about the fiction). The dial therefore selects **what kind of civilisation can know things**: conservative → residue → inference → mages, schools, experiment; ex-nihilo → nothing to reason from → magic can only be *received* → priests and no mages. UNI-1's science/magic/theology trio as one scalar. | UNI-25 | **Stock, flow, and posture** — every incidence offers two things to take, and the choice is a magic system's entire moral structure asked five times: *the interest, or the principal?* **Druid and defiler run the same production against the same land; the only difference is rate**, measurable against the shipped NPP field (a druid's cap is the regeneration rate; a defiler eats the principal) — so patience-versus-urgency is derived, and the necromantic line (a renewable corpse vs a non-regrowing soul) falls where fiction always drew it. **Two reversibilities**: grammar-invertibility governs whether a *spell* undoes (dispel); whether the *world* restores is a property of **rates** — accumulation is regeneration-bounded, liquidation is not — so **a defiled world never recovers even if every production in its grammar inverts**. The asymmetry is thermodynamic, not metaphysical: the dispel works, the desert stays. "Seeing your butterfly" is **contact-tracing on the provenance graph**: point the already-shipped organ (`why`, `windows/historiography`, the Connection Graph) at the **player's own committed facts** and walk the forward chain to the consequence they seeded. Epidemiological reading: some NPCs/sites are **superspreaders of consequence** (high centrality → far-reaching butterfly); others are dead-ends — the wake's *reach* is the centrality of whom you touched. No new engine; a new *subject set* for provenance. **SHIPPED** as *The First Mark* (2026-07-22): the in-session `why`/`recount` already read the session's evolving ledger and already render each fact's provenance, so tracing the fired `turned-hostile` consequence back to the player's own `provoke` needed no new engine — only the minimal one-hop trace, locked by a control test that proves `why` fabricates no chain for an un-provoked NPC. Presence at a soft site → deep mark; at an inert site → none. Markability is a **spatial receptivity field**, and the latent-tension regions *are* the soft clay (ties UNI-32's bias-not-manufacture to a place). Sets UNI-33's per-site decay rate. Deferred; The First Mark treats receptivity as uniform | raw | med | founding brainstorm 2026-07-22 |

The **witness pole already ships** — `possess`/vessel is the read-only observer — so the modes also **stage the game's construction**: witness (shipped) → mortal-who-leaves-marks (The First Mark) → permadeath-with-consequence. Cross-links UNI-18 | raw | med | founding brainstorm 2026-07-22 |

| UNI-38 | **Pooled versus personal observation** — a people's sky-knowledge is many eyes across generations; a dragon's is one pair of eyes across centuries. `chorus::sky_capability` currently derives a culture's observational reach from its perception vector alone, and explicitly names a TECH-1 seam for "instruments, recorded observation" — but the *biological* twin of that seam is untouched: transmission and lifespan are themselves an observational instrument. A long-lived solitary is the only observer who has personally witnessed a rare celestial event (an eclipse season, a Long Count alignment); a short-lived people can only inherit it. This is the structural mirror of [[BIO-37]]'s shipped drift law — the same `sociality × lifespan` pair, applied to *observation* instead of *language change* — which is why it is worth building as a pair rather than a one-off. Causality is COMPUTABLE from resource-threading: have each rule application record its inputs and outputs, then edge n1→n2 wherever a name leaves n1 and enters n2 — no authored causal links, no linear logic required. Makes a trace a PARTIAL ORDER: ordered is causality, unordered is concurrency | elaborated | high | [frontier §causal-trace](frontier.md#the-causal-trace--the-fabula-as-a-partial-order) |
| UNI-linear-resources | Linear versus persistent — the ledger is append-only and contradiction-checked, which is the PERSISTENT modality; a resource logic's premise is the opposite, consumed by use. Two things survive translation even if the formalism never arrives: conservation becomes STRUCTURAL rather than asserted (a move is one rule and cannot leak), and multiplicity is expressible without indexing propositions by an integer, which planning formalisms cannot do. Whether any domain should be WRITTEN this way is open; that several are ABOUT conserved quantities is not | elaborated | med | [frontier §causal-trace](frontier.md#the-causal-trace--the-fabula-as-a-partial-order) |
| UNI-potential-game-reduction | N-agent equilibrium collapsing to ONE optimization — agents planning against a static world is cheap, agents planning while accounting for each other is N coupled problems, but for potential games a single optimization yields an equilibrium of the original game, provided pairwise interaction cost is SYMMETRIC. Determinism-friendly (one deterministic search rather than N interacting ones) and expressible as another `SearchSpace` impl. Caveat: the cited theorem is continuous; Monderer & Shapley's original is finite, which is where to look first | raw | low | Diehl et al. reading, 2026-08-01 |
| UNI-record-shape | The fact ledger, git history, the chronicle, and in-world historiography are one shape — an ordered record of state transitions with causal attribution — at four longevities, treated as unrelated. Not a call to unify them but a source of moves: each has solved problems the others have not, and the in-world ones model doubt while the out-of-world ones do not. | elaborated | med | [frontier §instrument-inward](frontier.md#the-instrument-turned-inward--the-project-as-its-own-subject) |

## The species-psychology substrate

| ID    | Idea                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Status     | Conf                     | Where                                                                                               |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| PSY-1 | Culture as scaffolding around psychology — a bounded per-species vector (threat response, deliberation latency, sociality mode, in-group radius, time horizon, status basis) upstream of the culture campaigns                                                                                                                                                                                                      | elaborated | high value / weak verify | [frontier §psychology](frontier.md#the-species-psychology-substrate--the-layer-beneath-the-cluster) |
| PSY-2 | De-privilege the goblin baseline — identity-vector-at-goblin and unqualified legacy stream labels are a measurement frame, not a design commitment; fix via epoch-suffixed label migration (ADR 0006) + an abstract reference baseline no species need occupy. **The baseline half shipped as The Manikin**: a named reference vector nobody occupies — no `KindId`, no registry row, nothing placeable — on all four vector families, so `0.5` reads as the neutral midpoint rather than one people's value. The stream-label half is untouched and still open | shipped (baseline half) | high | [The Manikin](../chronicle/the-manikin.md); [The Manikin spec](https://github.com/hornvale/hornvale/blob/main/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-the-manikin-design.md); [Campaign Y2-2 spec §11](https://github.com/hornvale/hornvale/blob/main/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-07-campaign-y2-2-the-eyes-design.md) |
| PSY-3 | No default-civilization attractor — the culture stack must land as readily near a non-European analogue (Heian Japan, Ptolemaic Egypt, Classic Maya) as near medieval Europe; the anti-goal generalizes PSY-2 from the goblin baseline to the whole output space, guarded by derive-from-psychology×subsistence×environment rather than templates (SOC-6), eventually a Lab distribution over derived-culture space | raw        | med                      | [frontier §psychology](frontier.md#the-species-psychology-substrate--the-layer-beneath-the-cluster) |
| PSY-4 | Deity valence — a phenomenon's deific *affect* (loved / feared / demonic), not just its salience, derives from the observer's perception + psychology vectors: a nocturnal keen-eyed prey species reads light-emitters as hostile (the sun a demon, the *new* moon a companion), and high `threat_response` × keen `night_vision` can flip *all* emitters negative. The affective sibling of the salience-lens *attention* axis already shipped in `worldgen::perception_lens` (which sizes gods but not their goodness); today `religion::Sentiment` is temporal-only (Eternal/Cyclic/Ambient), carrying no love/fear. Kin to UNI-12 (projection at two valences) and BIO-14 (a fear-eater deified as devil). A religion/psychology consumer feature — not deep-time substrate; Firm Ground II (Campaign 19) proves the placed observer but builds no such consumer | raw        | med                      | [frontier §psychology](frontier.md#the-species-psychology-substrate--the-layer-beneath-the-cluster) |
| PSY-5 | Ideonomic cognition — novel thought as seeded combinatorics (Gunkel's ideonomy via Grace Kind): ideation as a closed, authored catalog of structural operators (negate / substitute / combine / abstract-and-reinstantiate) firing on seeded draws over a creature's held concepts — possibly the only theory of creativity that is constitutionally legal (models author, dice roll; REJ-6). Intake is phenomena (salience doubles as provocation), output is expressed behavior transmissible only by observation; an idea's lifecycle is a state machine (latent → noticed → held → expressed → transmitted → ritualized) whose held → mutated edge is where operators fire — taboo-negation as inversion, substitution as variant technique, combination as syncretism, mis-instantiated abstraction as superstition (UNI-1's error term, UNI-12's generator), ritual stickiness as cultural conservatism. Tier 0 is drift-without-ideation (MEM-3 noise); open primitives are evaluation (keep vs discard), the per-creature repertoire, and target selection. Downstream of PSY-1 (drives) and LANG-4's concept layer | elaborated | med                      | [frontier §ideonomic](frontier.md#ideonomic-cognition--novel-thought-as-seeded-combinatorics) |
| PSY-6 | The motivation engine (GOAP over belief) — rank motivation by autonomy (reflex → drive → emotion → goal → value → project) and every rung is a *setpoint*; an agent acts to close the gap between its setpoints and its *perceived* world. The algorithm is Goal-Oriented Action Planning (Orkin / F.E.A.R.), and every part already exists in the kernel: world-state = the fact ledger, actions (preconditions→effects) = authored verbs whose effects are events (models author, dice roll — MAP-5), goal = the ladder's setpoint, planner = A* (deterministic, seed-tiebroken — constitution-native, the one game-AI with no RNG). Decisive move: the planner reads the *projection* (belief, UNI-16), not truth, so plans can be WRONG — deception / charm / rumor steer behavior for free, and motivation + belief are one active-inference loop (perceive = fit model to world, act = fit world to model, same gap). Cost function = species / culture psychology vector (personality, deterministic, per-agent). Reactive rungs = utility-AI floor; deliberative = GOAP. Runs lazily for observed agents; closes the observation cycle for NPCs. Milestone-2 liveness engine, twin to the social graph (SOC-9), downstream of PSY-1 drives, deliberative complement to PSY-5. **The Quickening (2026-07-18) shipped Milestone 2's first liveness slice without this engine**: an NPC's setpoint is honored only conceptually — a fixed activity-cycle phase (diurnal/nocturnal/crepuscular) standing in for a drive, not a GOAP-planned goal — and its route is a hand-authored two-point schedule (home ⇌ one fixed neighbor), never a planned path. The planner, the needs, and the autonomy ladder above reflex are all still exactly as deferred as before; what changed is that a real committed event (a derived NPC's dated `agent-at`) now exists for a future planner to eventually act *into*. **The Wanting (2026-07-18) shipped the DRIVE rung** — one rung up from The Quickening's bare activity-cycle phase, and the campaign this row's ladder was written to anticipate: a real homeostatic setpoint (a single sustenance drive) is a pure FOLD over an NPC's own committed `agent-at` history (UNI-20 — a drive is a derived view, structurally identical to belief and the c4 query indexes, never a second source of truth), rising away from its resource and falling at it, with a hysteresis dead-band (two thresholds, not one) preventing the thrash a memoryless drive would produce — which is exactly why the drive rung needs MEMORY and reflex does not. Cardinality-1 by design: ONE drive needs no arbitration, and arbitration between COMPETING drives is precisely what the GOAL rung (A* search, the psychology/culture cost function below) exists to resolve, so this slice deliberately stops one rung short of it, not for lack of ambition but because building the planner now would have nothing to arbitrate. The seam is now RESERVED, not built (decision-ledger #9): `decide(npc, world_view, t) -> Intent` is the degenerate one-goal case of goal-selection-then-planning, and `world_view` abstracts what the agent perceives — ground truth today, UNI-16's belief later (the same `view` slot, a body change not a seam change) — so the eventual multi-drive GOAP planner replaces `decide`'s body and adds a second drive, never the tick/commit/read architecture around it. **The Foresight (2026-07-18) shipped the GOAL rung** — the reserved seam's first body-swap: `decide` now runs the kernel A* (`hornvale_kernel::astar` over `SearchSpace`, UNI-19's general engine — this is its first instantiation) from the current world-state to the drive-generated goal (`hydrated`) and returns the plan's first action; `Intent` generalized from `{GoTo, Hold}` to `{Do(Action), Hold}` exactly as the seam anticipated, with the tick still depending on nothing but that output. The essence that makes this GOAP rather than pathfinding is a PRECONDITION CHAIN: the goal is `hydrated`, not "at the water," and the only action achieving it (`Drink`) is gated by an unmet precondition (at-water) the planner must establish with a run of `MoveTo`s first — `[move*, drink]`, discovered by search, over a deliberately minimal two-action space (the MAP-27 verb-chemistry DSL is a named followup, not built here). Still cardinality-1 (one drive, no arbitration), still uniform action cost (no psychology vector), still ground-truth `view` (no belief) — each the next body-swap this campaign leaves reserved, not a regression from ambition. Failure modes are the drama (from a negation pass): satisficing not optimizing, no-plan-found → despair / substitution / delusion (replan over false belief), anti-optimal ordeal, adversarial planning (the con), and plan side-effects minting SOC-9 enmity edges. Cycle-03 of the room-scale corpus (encounters / trophic / inhabitants-as-agents) is a spatial/ecological elaboration of this engine ([cycle-03](https://github.com/hornvale/hornvale/blob/main/docs/design/room-scale/cycle-03-the-living-layer.md)). **The Temperament (2026-07-20) shipped the ARBITRATION rung** — the competing-drives resolution this row named as the goal rung's reason to exist: a second drive (thermal comfort, a flow-drive reading the cell temperature against the species niche) meets thirst in one action-centric `arbitrate` — utility = Σ_active capped-urgency × serviceability, survival capped above comfort (soft Maslow, no priority table), committed with hysteresis. Psychology enters as ONE dial — `deliberation_latency` slides *grab* (loudest drive only) ↔ *weigh* (full weighted sum) — the psychology/culture cost function this row anticipated, in its first runtime form. `decide` is the degenerate one-drive case, byte-identical to The Foresight's. Still ground-truth `view` (belief is the next body-swap). The affect read (PSY-7) and a self-scoring population health metric fall out of the same arbitration, and cold/heat earn their cognitive handle (the correspondence audit's cognition column 0/76 → 2/76 — the wave this campaign opened). **Followup #4 (2026-07-20) wired the SECOND psychology dial, `time_horizon`** (anticipation): a foresighted creature pre-empts a projectable STOCK drive, engaging it before its urgency crosses `act` by a lead proportional to the urgency it will accrue over its planning horizon (`Drive::anticipation_lead`; thirst climbs predictably so it leads, a FLOW drive has no trajectory to project so it grants none). Zero foresight is byte-identical to the pre-anticipation model. The psychology/culture cost function this row named now has two runtime dials (grab↔weigh, and myopic↔foresighted), the arbitration's felt-state and health readouts unchanged. **The Slumber (2026-07-20) shipped the THIRD drive, fatigue, and woke the dormant activity cycle**: a stock sleep-debt drive (Process S) + a wake-gate (Process C) that engages a creature only while awake — thirst/thermal fall silent asleep (a survival override wakes a dying creature), a creature rests in place, and the health metric samples at a waking moment. Shipped as the Tier-0 fractional-day wake cycle; the general chronobiology engine (PSY-9) is the registered followup. **The Provender (2026-07-20) shipped the FOURTH drive, hunger** — the thirst homeostat parameterized by the species' diet niche (the `ResourceVector` as the diet dial, read as a continuous mix, never branched on a diet type), reusing The Kindling's temperature-coupled path integral as a second consumer and food as a graded productivity field the drive grazes toward. The general trophic engine (PSY-10) is the registered followup; active predation is deferred to it. **The Dread (2026-07-21) shipped the FIFTH drive, danger/fear** — the avoidance twin of hunger (`threat_niche · hazard_field` = `diet_niche · resource_field` sign-flipped): a FLOW drive (like thermal) that flees a hazard field (v1: the uncanny — placed-exotic strangeness — plus a lethal-temperature backstop) down its gradient, with SIGNED (unclamped) serviceability so a step into worse danger scores negative and danger reshapes the other drives' paths (a thirsty creature routes around a hazard). Urgency is anticipatory (max threat over the cell + neighbours) so the veto engages while a hazard is adjacent. No new fact, no new action (flee is a `MoveTo`) — the leanest drive, genesis AND the seed-42 possession walk byte-identical. v1 niche-less (ametabolic → fearless); the threat niche, boldness dial, and predator-as-hazard are reserved (PSY-11 / PSY-10). **The Belonging (2026-07-21) shipped the SIXTH & LAST drive, social affiliation** — the first drive whose field is OTHER AGENTS, shaped like thermal comfort (sociality has an OPTIMUM, not monotone), company proxied in v1 by HOME-PROXIMITY. Comfort-tier, reachability-gated (a lonely creature within homing range heads home reading *Searching*; beyond reach the drive goes DORMANT, not distress — an unreachable home is a relocation, not a death), so a natural world is never chronically lonely (null-control holds) and a stranded creature's survival distress stays unmasked. No new fact/action; genesis + seed-42 possession walk byte-identical. | PSY-12 | **The affiliation/belonging engine — sociality as a drive, the first OTHER-directed drive.** The generalization The Belonging's social drive is the first instance of: where thirst/hunger read the self and thermal/danger read the environment, affiliation reads a third field — the presence of one's own kind. Shaped like thermal comfort (sociality has an OPTIMUM — too lonely and too crowded both cost), it is the root of a whole subtree the drive layer will grow into. **The Belonging shipped the `(home-proximity, head-home)` instance** — comfort-tier, reachability-gated (reachable home → *Searching*; unreachable → dormant, since loneliness is comfort not survival). Deferred, correct-by-construction: the **population field** (Tier-1 — company as a spatial field over nearby settlement population, affiliate at *any* village, dissolving the reachability discontinuity); **attachment** (perceive and seek *specific* others — kin, mate, allies — the first true multi-agent perception, whose determinism is handled deliberately, the reason v1 uses a field not agents); the **gregariousness niche** (the sociality setpoint solitary ↔ eusocial, where the *solitary* pole flips the sign — others *repel*, crowding stress, the twin of the diet niche PSY-11 and threat niche); **status / dominance** (the hierarchical dimension, reading the authored `Sociality` Hierarchic/Communal and `in_group_radius` — the invented structure atop the discovered urge, into the culture stack SOC-9); **out-group aversion** (a stranger as a mild threat — where affiliation meets The Dread, PSY-11); and **construct/hive affiliation** (the ametabolic own-drive — a swarm-node seeking its cluster). Deception then needs no module: faking is planning a display that misrepresents state. | PSY-7 | Emotion as appraisal — the affective readout of the gap. Decompose an emotion and it's a bundle of appraisals (Scherer / Lazarus / OCC), each computed by a system the game has: valence/arousal from the motivation gap (PSY-6), agency/blame from event provenance + the social graph (SOC-9), expectedness from prediction-error vs belief (UNI-16), coping from whether GOAP finds a plan. Substitution over one appraisal generates the family: same event (ally killed) → blame = circumstance = grief, blame = enemy = rage, blame = self = guilt, plan-exists = resolve (M+N over appraisal dims, not an emotion table). Derived structurally from the decision (met/known/unknown/blocked), not an emotion table (the M+N-over-appraisals shape). | PSY-8 | **The psych vector already supplies magic's discount rates.** Incidence (UNI-24) *is* a discount rate — how much you discount harm you do not bear — and economics has exactly two, social and temporal; `MindVector` and `SocietyVector` ship both. **`in_group_radius`** ("how wide 'us' is drawn", idle since the-gathering) is the **social** discount: insular → externalise onto outsiders → sacrifice, blood magic. **`time_horizon`** ("how far ahead works are planned") is the **temporal** one: immediate → borrow against a later era → Athas. **`deliberation_latency`** (explicitly "idle this campaign; banked") governs how deep a derivation search a people runs, and so answers the question the ideonomic-cognition section already preregistered — *"does a high-deliberation-latency species innovate slower but retain better?"* **`status_basis`** decides which UNI-25 posture confers standing, hence whether a civilisation grows monasteries (savings), an Athas (liquidation), or a theocracy (credit). **A species' magical style is therefore a readout of already-drawn values, not a new parameter** — the four goblinoids already carry distinct incidence signatures, and druid and defiler are opposite corners of the same two dimensions. Potency likewise: read `sovereignty_floor`'s budget `e = a·ln(mass_kg) + b·potency` for casting and **mass and potency are additive into one buffering capacity, therefore substitutes** — so **potency is the capacity to absorb your own debt**, with the bargain in the coefficients: mass logarithmic and *trainable*, potency linear, ~7× more efficient per unit, and *drawn at birth*. Hence the psion's discipline is real and rate-limited (strength buys the **stock** — how much you absorb at once; endurance buys the **flow** — how fast you refill; and asceticism is **budget reallocation**, every unsatisfied drive freeing capacity, which is why austerity is universally associated with mystical power and why in a self-incidence world that association is simply correct accounting). Crossing potency against repertoire yields **the defiler as an emergent quadrant** rather than a choice: high potency + low repertoire is the dragon, which does not defile because it need not; low potency + high repertoire is the scholar whose knowledge outruns the body that must fund it, so the debt goes outward. The frail scholar burns the world; the dragon simply is. Places the menagerie's mighty roster (`potency > 0`) as natural casters, not researchers | elaborated | med | [frontier §magic](frontier.md#magic-as-a-graph-grammar--the-debt-economy) |

Determinism-safe over the kernel's A* (costs derived, ties already totally ordered). Humans and goblins raid now. Individual tier and slow edges deferred; selection still wants tails, so the elf radiation unblocks here. Kin to [[BIO-17]] | shipped | high | [The Tolerance chronicle](../chronicle/the-tolerance.md) |
| PSY-distribution-shape | **A dispersion needs a SHAPE, not just a width.** [[PSY-dispersion]] authors one spread per vector and draws it uniform on +/-sqrt(3)*sigma: width but **no tails**, and no way to express two modes. Blocks nothing today; it matters for the elf radiation, where selection acts on tails a uniform lacks. | SOC-9 | The social graph — the relational layer that makes a world alive: kinship / affection / enmity / debt / trust / allegiance as typed directed edges, *one graph derived from the event ledger* (a bond = the reduction of past events between a pair; provenanced; trust rides the UNI-16 immune threshold — slow to build, instant to break). Topology hands over structure & story unauthored: cycles are drama (reciprocity = alliance, feud loop = vendetta, triangle = tragedy), triads *self-balance* (Heider structural balance relaxes unbalanced triangles deterministically — a liveness engine with no RNG, the social form of surprise-is-epistemic), brokers (high betweenness) are power. Cycle-03 of the room-scale corpus (culture / factions / feuds) is a spatial/ecological elaboration of this graph ([cycle-03](https://github.com/hornvale/hornvale/blob/main/docs/design/room-scale/cycle-03-the-living-layer.md)) | elaborated | high (mechanics) | [frontier §social-graph](frontier.md#the-social-graph--a-derived-self-balancing-relational-layer) |
| SOC-death-edge | Death is the one graph operation [[SOC-9]] never specifies, and it is not deletion — a bond there is *a reduction of past events between a pair* and the ledger is append-only, so the edge outlives its counterparty. **The graph remembers the dead.** What ends is only the capacity to generate new events, which makes grief a live edge to an inert node and needs no new state at all. Mourning intensity follows edge weight, mourning *duty* follows edge type, and whether a debt transfers is descent mode's call — a culture axis that already ships | raw | high | ideonomy session 2026-07-31 (agent-based grief); [frontier §social-graph](frontier.md#the-social-graph--a-derived-self-balancing-relational-layer) |
| SOC-death-magnitude | The social magnitude of a death is a graph property, so which deaths matter is derived rather than authored. [[SOC-9]] makes brokers powerful by betweenness; retiring a broker's *capacity* redistributes betweenness across everyone who routed through them, so a loss reshaping the status hierarchy is a recomputation with no RNG — the same Heider-style relaxation one rung up. It also hands delivery a principled filter: an elder's death is reportable and a stranger's is not, for a reason a metric can state ([[NARR-attention-budget]]) | raw | high | ideonomy session 2026-07-31 (agent-based grief); [frontier §social-graph](frontier.md#the-social-graph--a-derived-self-balancing-relational-layer) |
| SOC-mourning-period | Grief is periodic, not decaying — and the objection to "a sadness variable that goes down over time" has a positive answer already in the kernel. Mourning is observed on a *schedule*: rites at intervals, anniversaries, an annual day for the dead. Represent it as a recurring observance with a culturally drawn period (`Phenomenon.period_days` ships, and religion already derives rites from salient phenomena) and the way grief returns falls out with no decay curve, no half-life, nothing to calibrate | raw | med | ideonomy session 2026-07-31 (agent-based grief) |
| SOC-10 | The living community — peoples-diversity's missing axis is *time*. Near-identical peoples are told apart by history, not resources (Basques are displacement residue, not a niche). Diversity reads out of a derived history: a coarse forward-sim at genesis over structural pressures only, resolving into dated biographies. Displacement is the diversity generator. **Shipped** (campaign 1 of ~5): genesis grows settlements over ~2000 years instead of placing them, separating four near-identical goblinoids by history not niche. Remaining: [[MAP-61]], [[SOC-criticality]], [[UNI-30]], [[SOC-11]] | shipped | med | [The Living Community](../chronicle/the-living-community.md); [frontier §living-community](frontier.md#the-living-community--history-as-a-baked-derivable-biography) |
| SOC-11 | The institutional layer — a mid-scale social structure between the community and the persona: a court, a bureaucracy, a guild, a temple hierarchy, a slave system, an army. Surfaced by the drow-aide vignette (a chamberlain's minor aide overseeing slave-maintained sewers — a persona embedded in an *institution*, not a settlement). The five-level ontology (species / culture / community / persona / individual, [[SOC-10]]) does not cleanly name it: an institution is a persistent entity with *roles*, a *hierarchy*, and a *function*, cross-cutting communities (a trade guild spans ports; a queen's court outlives its courtiers). Likely a derived layer over the same event ledger — an institution = a bundle of role-handles + a standing relation among them — not a new domain; kin to the relational [[SOC-9]] but with named offices rather than dyadic bonds. Deferred: an ontology question for the living-community sequel, out of scope for the feasibility benchmark. | raw | med | [frontier §living-community](frontier.md#the-living-community--history-as-a-baked-derivable-biography) |
| SOC-particular | A person is an occupation's already-derived founder handle raised to a ledger entity, so identity is material and the entity is only an address. Memory takes a **holder** — each people remembers at most twenty of its own founders — so the cast is *at most* the sum over peoples of min(20, occupations), growing with the roster rather than a retuned constant. Confirmed by a campaign not testing it: 148 founders on seed 42 at fifteen peoples, up from 117 at nine. An upper bound since [[MEM-founder-handle-epoch]] | shipped | high | [The Particular](../chronicle/the-particular.md); [The Radiation](../chronicle/the-radiation.md) |
| SOC-authority-per-domain | `Sociality` has two variants and authority is not one thing. `Hierarchic` versus `Communal` collapses centralisation, formalisation, whether standing is achieved or ascribed, and — the one that dissolves the binary — whether authority is domain-general at all.
